performance.verdict: $625 spent, zero leads confirmed — tracking is broken, not the ads.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $624.81 spent across 28 days, 0 leads recorded in any channel. 132 Google clicks reached 683 GA4 sessions but zero conversions — tracking is broken at intake.
OVERDUE: 5 milestones past due (Jul 20 – Aug 31) including Paid Landing Pages Live and End-to-End Stack Re-Test ⛔ — scaling is blocked until these clear.
3-day spend signal (Aug 30–Sep 1): $6.86 / $53.34 / $12.86 vs prior 3-day avg $14.23 — erratic daily pacing suggests budget is not deploying consistently on the top campaign.
GBP drove 49 direction actions in 28 days but 0 calls and 0 leads — organic intent exists but the conversion path (phone or landing page) is not completing.
GHL shows 126 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — if leads ever start flowing, the pipeline intake and close path are unvalidated and likely broken.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking and landing page form submission — $624.81 spent with 0 leads recorded.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $624.81 over 28 days with 132 clicks reaching 683 GA4 sessions but zero conversions recorded anywhere. The Paid Landing Pages Live milestone (due Aug 31) is overdue and the End-to-End Stack Re-Test ⛔ has not been completed — these are the most likely causes of zero lead capture. Action: verify the thank-you/confirmation page fires the Google Ads conversion tag, test the landing page form end-to-end, and confirm GHL receives the submission. Success check: at least 1 confirmed lead recorded in GHL and Google Ads within 48 hours of the fix going live; re-check by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Do not increase Google Ads budget above current $18.53/day avg until tracking fix confirms leads are flowing.
suggestions.monday_update: Daily spend is erratic ($1.38 on Aug 29, $53.34 on Aug 31) and zero leads are being captured, so any budget increase compounds waste. Hold the current daily budget and monitor for 3 consecutive days of confirmed lead delivery before considering a scale move. Re-check on 2026-09-05 after the tracking fix (S1) is validated.
